_source: Extracted from the live portfolio2 stylesheet at https://unrealumanga.github.io/portfolio2/assets/css/style.css — these are the user's OWN published tokens, not the placeholder palette in LLM-SOC-012 §5.1.
_identity_note: LLM-SOC-012 §2.0 / GATE 6: no Ochre mark, colour system or wordmark appears anywhere in these assets. Ochre supplies sentence cadence only.

type._installed: Onest[wght].ttf from google/fonts, installed to ~/.local/share/fonts. Same family as portfolio2 and portfolio3.

_measured_contrast._method: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance, computed not assumed (LLM-SOC-013 S4).

_usage_rules: PAPER ground: ink for titles (17.0:1), ink_soft for metadata (7.05:1).
DARK ground: paper/white for titles (17.8:1), acid for the single accent (16.44:1).
NEVER acid on paper — measured 1.04:1, effectively invisible. This is why statement cards use a dark ground: it is the only ground on which the accent functions.
NEVER ink_soft on a dark ground — 2.41:1.
Acid is the one emphasis device per frame (LLM-SOC-012 §5.3, signalling principle).
